facts.fact: The article says Aviso n.6/2019 of 18 July 2019 on payment institutions and e-money institutions stands, and that no later changes were found in the outlet's check.
Aviso n.6/2019 sets minimum capital for payment institutions (2 million escudos for remittance only, 5 million for one service, 10 million for others) and 20 million for e-money institutions.
